heading: Drinking water fountain replacement for schools

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: Not later than 1 year after October 23, 2018, the Administrator shall establish a grant program to provide assistance to local educational agencies for the replacement of drinking water fountains manufactured prior to 1988.

tree.heading: Use of funds
tree.text: Funds awarded under the grant program—

children.text: shall be used to pay the costs of replacement of drinking water fountains in schools; and

may be used to pay the costs of monitoring and reporting of lead levels in the drinking water of schools of a local educational agency receiving such funds, as determined appropriate by the Administrator.

tree.heading: Priority
tree.text: In awarding funds under the grant program, the Administrator shall give priority to local educational agencies based on economic need.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to carry out this section $5,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2019 through 2021.
